description: Answer one question: can this specific product actually be returned? Give a product_url and buyer_country and you get a verified verdict — YES / YES_WITH_CONDITIONS / NO / UNKNOWN — with the exact policy clause quoted verbatim, the source URL, the return window and a confidence score. Coverage, measured not claimed: on 50 real US retailers (frozen list, 2026-08-28) the policy was reached for 17. The rest are stores that serve no policy text to anything but a real browser. Pass page_text yourself and those work too. Never invents: returns UNKNOWN instead of guessing, and UNKNOWN is free.

membership.description: Loyalty tier, if the buyer has one (e.g. 'Plus').

page_html.description: Optional: raw HTML, if you already have it.

page_text.description: Optional: the page text, if you already have it. If omitted, this package fetches it locally.

name: check_return
